Insured Georgia Home Contractor

You're looking for a reliable and insured home contractor in Georgia, and Build Heritage is here to help. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your home service needs, and our team will respond within one business day.

Getting Your Quote

To get started, you can fill out the quote form or contact us at info@buildheritage.org. We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, including areas like Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. Our team of experts offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, and roofing. We'll provide you with a detailed quote, and our cost guide can give you an idea of what to expect, with prices ranging from $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint to $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement.

What You Get

As a licensed and insured contractor in Georgia, we prioritize quality and trust. Our cost guide, updated in August 2026, advises holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues. We're transparent about our services and costs, so you can make informed decisions about your home.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How do I get a quote? You can fill out the quote form or contact us at info@buildheritage.org. Are you licensed and insured? Yes, we are licensed and insured in Georgia.

Get your free quote today
